settings.heading: Hands, memory, and many small decisions.
settings.intro: Every Shukla rug carries the character of the people who make it.
settings.body: In Bhadohi, weaving knowledge passes between generations. We work with artisan partners whose skill brings texture, rhythm, and quiet irregularity to every piece.

settings.heading: A living craft
settings.text: Traditional techniques meet contemporary palettes and proportions.

settings.heading: Respectful partnership
settings.text: We build lasting relationships around fair, careful production.

settings.heading: Made, not manufactured
settings.text: Small variations are evidence of the hand behind your rug.
